scenes.tts: If T M C one lines the pore, why does the current also depend on other proteins?
scenes.caption: If TMC1 lines the pore, why does the current also depend on other proteins?
scenes.visual: Title card: A Pore Inside a Complex. TMC1 at the centre, with three faded partner shapes around it.
scenes.narration: If TMC1 lines the pore, why does the current also depend on other proteins?

scenes.tts: No native mammalian structure was available, so Jeong, Clark and colleagues turned to a worm.
scenes.visual: Label: Jeong, Clark and colleagues, 2022. A small nematode, C. elegans.
scenes.narration: No native mammalian structure was available, so Jeong, Clark and colleagues turned to a worm.

scenes.tts: They purified the native T M C one complex from C elegans, and solved it by cryo electron microscopy.
scenes.caption: They purified the native TMC-1 complex from C. elegans, and solved it by cryo-EM.
scenes.visual: Many particle images combine into a three-dimensional map. Label: cryo-EM, worm TMC-1 complex.
scenes.narration: They purified the native TMC-1 complex from C. elegans, and solved it by cryo-EM.

scenes.tts: The main assembly held two copies each of T M C one, CALM one, and T M I E.
scenes.caption: The main assembly held two copies each of TMC-1, CALM-1, and TMIE.
scenes.visual: The map resolves into subunits labelled TMC-1 (two), CALM-1 (two) and TMIE (two). Label: worm complex.
scenes.narration: The main assembly held two copies each of TMC-1, CALM-1, and TMIE.

scenes.tts: CALM one is the worm relative of the mammalian protein C I B two.
scenes.caption: CALM-1 is the worm relative of the mammalian protein CIB2.
scenes.visual: CALM-1 linked by an arrow to CIB2. Label: worm orthologue.
scenes.narration: CALM-1 is the worm relative of the mammalian protein CIB2.

scenes.tts: The human complex in that paper was a model built on the worm structure, not a measurement.
scenes.visual: A faded human complex drawn over the worm map. Label: model, not measured.
scenes.narration: The human complex in that paper was a model built on the worm structure, not a measurement.

scenes.tts: Read the mouse partners through the three factors. Without C I B two, cochlear stereocilia showed no detectable T M C one or T M C two. So the channel count at the site falls.
scenes.caption: Read the mouse partners through the three factors. Without CIB2, cochlear stereocilia showed no detectable TMC1 or TMC2. So the channel count at the site falls.
scenes.visual: The counters N, i and P_open return beside three partner cards: CIB2, TMIE, LHFPL5. The CIB2 card lights the N counter. Label: cochlear hair cells; TMC signal undetectable.
scenes.narration: Read the mouse partners through the three factors. Without CIB2, cochlear stereocilia showed no detectable TMC1 or TMC2. So the channel count at the site falls.

scenes.tts: Without T M I E, tagged T M C one could not be detected in the stereocilia either.
scenes.caption: Without TMIE, tagged TMC1 could not be detected in the stereocilia either.
scenes.visual: The TMIE card dimly lights the N counter. Label: Tmie-null outer hair cells; tagged TMC1 not detected.
scenes.narration: Without TMIE, tagged TMC1 could not be detected in the stereocilia either.

scenes.tts: Predict. Overexpressed T M C one still reaches the stereocilia there, yet gives no current. What does that tell you?
scenes.caption: Predict. Overexpressed TMC1 still reaches the stereocilia there, yet gives no current. What does that tell you?
scenes.visual: Overexpressed TMC1 protein shown in the stereocilia; the current trace stays flat. Text: protein there, still no current. Why?
scenes.narration: Predict. Overexpressed TMC1 still reaches the stereocilia there, yet gives no current. What does that tell you?

scenes.tts: T M I E is needed for more than getting T M C one there. It may help build, couple or gate a working channel.
scenes.caption: TMIE is needed for more than getting TMC1 there. It may help build, couple or gate a working channel.
scenes.visual: A question mark sits over all three counters under the TMIE card. Label: protein localized; working channel not established.
scenes.narration: TMIE is needed for more than getting TMC1 there. It may help build, couple or gate a working channel.

scenes.tts: Deafness-linked T M I E mutations also lowered the unitary current. In cells where T M C two carried the current, they changed calcium permeability.
scenes.caption: Deafness-linked TMIE mutations also lowered the unitary current. In cells where TMC2 carried the current, they changed calcium permeability.
scenes.visual: The i counter glows under the TMIE card. Then a TMC2-only channel: fewer calcium icons pass.
scenes.narration: Deafness-linked TMIE mutations also lowered the unitary current. In cells where TMC2 carried the current, they changed calcium permeability.

scenes.tts: So T M I E shapes the pore's properties, without being shown to be the pore.
scenes.caption: So TMIE shapes the pore's properties, without being shown to be the pore.
scenes.visual: Label: shapes the pore, not shown to be the pore.
scenes.narration: So TMIE shapes the pore's properties, without being shown to be the pore.

scenes.tts: L H F P L five binds the tip-link protein P C D H fifteen. Without it, Xiong and colleagues saw smaller single-channel events in twenty twelve. Later recordings with T M C one only channels found no change, so its molecular effect is still open.
scenes.caption: LHFPL5 binds the tip-link protein PCDH15. Without it, Xiong and colleagues saw smaller single-channel events in 2012. Later recordings with TMC1-only channels found no change, so its molecular effect is still open.
scenes.visual: The LHFPL5 card attaches to PCDH15 on a tip link; the i counter dims with a small question mark beside it. Label: 2012: smaller unitary events; later TMC1-only cells: unchanged; also affects coupling and activation.
scenes.narration: LHFPL5 binds the tip-link protein PCDH15. Without it, Xiong and colleagues saw smaller single-channel events in 2012. Later recordings with TMC1-only channels found no change, so its molecular effect is still open.

scenes.tts: The current you measure belongs to the complex, not to one protein.
scenes.visual: All three partner cards and TMC1 group into one complex beside the counters.
scenes.narration: The current you measure belongs to the complex, not to one protein.

scenes.tts: Even a complete ladder leaves one question open. How does force from the tip link reach the pore?
scenes.visual: A tip link above the complex, with a question mark on the path from the link to the pore.
scenes.narration: Even a complete ladder leaves one question open. How does force from the tip link reach the pore?

scenes.tts: Of each experiment, ask which factor it tested. The case for the pore rests on several rungs together.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: I = N × i × P_open beside the evidence ladder. Permeation, accessibility and activity alone light together, supported by localization, loss and rescue.
scenes.narration: Of each experiment, ask which factor it tested. The case for the pore rests on several rungs together.
